gbm_population_evidence.quote: Lynch syndrome-related cancers (colorectal, endometrial, gastric, ovarian, pancreatic, urothelial, brain (usually glioblastoma), biliary tract, small intestine)

candidate_evidence.quote: [OTHER] Enhanced education: In addition to the education conducted as part of usual care, the nurse will: 1) provide basic education on GCT; and 2) if the patient is eligible and agreeable to GCT, place a referral to GCT (if not already ordered).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Starting new systemic therapy or switching systemic therapy

coder_notes: Behavioural/educational trial (phase NA) of nurse-led genetic counselling and testing referral in solid tumours; no drug interventions. Glioblastoma named in inclusion criteria as a Lynch-related brain tumour -> basket_gbm_eligible. Germline genetic testing is not a tumour biomarker, so no biomarkers recorded.
